# FEC Top Individual Donors — by cycle (banked Schedule A, 2016–2026)

**Coverage of this extract:** Schedule A aggregation computed this run over 6 of 6 banked modern cycles (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2026). All six banked cycles are in. Every figure states its basis inline; nothing is estimated or filled in.

## Identity basis — read before citing

Donors are aggregated on **(contributor name as filed, first 5 digits of ZIP)** — the identity the banked rows themselves carry. This is name+ZIP identity, NOT resolved person identity: two people sharing a name and ZIP5 merge, and one person filing under name variants splits. Employer attribution is NOT used (the bank's measured employer-attribution rate is 1 of 168,093 donation edges — the EMPLOYER field exists at itcont position 12 but no banked parse welds it). Amounts are NET as filed over the donor set (ENTITY_TP = IND, MEMO_CD != 'X'; memo/earmarked re-statements excluded to avoid double-counting).

# FEC Top Committees — by Schedule A individual receipts (banked cycles 2016–2026)

**Coverage of this extract:** Schedule A aggregation computed this run over 6 of 6 banked modern cycles (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2026). All six banked cycles are in. Every figure states its basis inline; nothing is estimated or filled in.

## What this ranking is — and is not

Committees are ranked by **individual-contribution receipts aggregated from the banked Schedule A bulk files** (dataset `fec_sched_a`, itcont.txt members): the donor set is rows with ENTITY_TP = IND and MEMO_CD != 'X' (memo entries excluded — they re-state earmarked gifts already counted at the conduit, so including them would double-count). Amounts are NET as filed (refunds and offsets are negative rows and are summed, not dropped). A second column gives each committee's GROSS Schedule A volume over ALL rows (every entity type, memo rows included) for scale.

**What this is NOT:** it is not the committees' official total receipts (Schedule A itemized contributions are one line of a committee's receipts; unitemized contributions, transfers, loans and offsets live on summary pages that are NOT banked as parses), and **disbursement rankings are not computable from the banked parses at all** — no Schedule B or committee-summary parse exists in the bank (verified by census this run: `chain/fec_bulk/stage1-clean/v20261017/` holds committee-master parses only). Committee names/types/party/connected-org below are from the same cycle's banked committee-master parse (G14, `chain/fec_bulk/stage1-clean/v20261017/cmYY.csv`).

**Coverage of this extract:** Schedule A aggregation computed this run over 6 of 6 banked modern cycles (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2026). All six banked cycles are in. Every figure states its basis inline; nothing is estimated or filled in.

## Edge families in this extract

1. **Shared individual donors** (this run's Schedule A aggregation): two committees are edged when the same (name, ZIP5) donor gave to both in the same cycle; weight = shared-donor count and the donor's combined dollars to the pair. Identity is name+ZIP as filed (see the donors file for the standing caveat).
2. **Shared treasurer** (banked committee-master parses): committees listing the same treasurer name as filed — the classic professional-treasurer web. Pairs are emitted for treasurer groups of 2–60 committees; larger groups (professional firms) are counted and named below instead of pair-expanded.
3. **Connected-org families**: committees whose master record names the same connected organization (corporate/union PAC families).
4. **Candidate–committee linkages**: cm CAND_ID fields (all cycles) plus the FEC candidate-committee linkage files ccl24/ccl26 with their LINKAGE_IDs (banked 2026-10-18 under `fec_sched_a` v20261017).
